name: tokens
title: Design Tokens
description: 3-layer tokens (primitives, semantic, component) as CSS custom properties

files.content:
/**
 * Do not edit directly, this file was auto-generated.
 */

:root {
  --color-white: #ffffff;
  --color-black: #000000;
  --color-brand: #ff6600; /** Atom brand orange */
  --color-neutral-50: #fafafa; /** ATOM neutral ramp */
  --color-neutral-100: #f5f5f5;
  --color-neutral-150: #efefef; /** ATOM mid-step between 100 and 200 */
  --color-neutral-200: #e5e5e5;
  --color-neutral-300: #d4d4d4;
  --color-neutral-400: #a3a3a3;
  --color-neutral-500: #737373;
  --color-neutral-600: #525252;
  --color-neutral-700: #404040;
  --color-neutral-800: #262626;
  --color-neutral-850: #1a1a1a; /** ATOM mid-step between 800 and 900 */
  --color-neutral-900: #171717;
  --color-neutral-950: #0a0a0a;
  --color-neutral-alpha-50: rgba(250, 250, 250, 0.7);
  --color-neutral-alpha-100: rgba(245, 245, 245, 0.7);
  --color-neutral-alpha-150: rgba(239, 239, 239, 0.7);
  --color-neutral-alpha-200: rgba(229, 229, 229, 0.7);
  --color-neutral-alpha-300: rgba(212, 212, 212, 0.7);
  --color-neutral-alpha-400: rgba(163, 163, 163, 0.7);
  --color-neutral-alpha-500: rgba(115, 115, 115, 0.7);
  --color-neutral-alpha-600: rgba(82, 82, 82, 0.7);
  --color-neutral-alpha-700: rgba(64, 64, 64, 0.7);
  --color-neutral-alpha-800: rgba(38, 38, 38, 0.7);
  --color-neutral-alpha-850: rgba(26, 26, 26, 0.7);
  --color-neutral-alpha-900: rgba(23, 23, 23, 0.7);
  --color-neutral-alpha-950: rgba(10, 10, 10, 0.7);
  --color-green-electric: #25d366; /** ATOM electric green accent (academy) */
  --color-forest: #0a290f; /** Deep forest green — corrects misnamed purple in academy tokens */
  --color-coral-300: #fb7a6e; /** Lighter coral for soft destructive surfaces */
  --color-coral-500: #f84131; /** ATOM coral — destructive base */
  --color-coral-700: #c21e12; /** Darker coral for destructive hover/pressed */
  --color-sky-500: #22d3ee; /** ATOM sky accent — info surfaces, link text on dark */
  --color-sky-700: #0e7490; /** Dark sky — link text on light backgrounds (5.1:1 on neutral-50) */
  --color-amber-50: #fffbea;
  --color-amber-100: #fff4c6;
  --color-amber-200: #fee685;
  --color-amber-300: #ffd230;
  --color-amber-400: #ffba00;
  --color-amber-500: #fe9900; /** Warning base */
  --color-amber-600: #e17100;
  --color-amber-700: #bb4d00;
  --color-amber-800: #973c00;
  --color-amber-900: #7b3306;
  --color-amber-950: #471901;
  --color-orange-50: #fff4ed; /** Brand orange ramp (Atom) */
  --color-orange-100: #ffdec8;
  --color-orange-200: #ffc8a4;
  --color-orange-300: #ff9d5b;
  --color-orange-400: #ff7c24;
  --color-orange-500: #ff6600;
  --color-orange-600: #db5700;
  --color-orange-700: #a44200;
  --color-orange-800: #803300;
  --color-orange-900: #5b2400;
  --color-orange-950: #371600;
  --color-violet-400: #bf44ff; /** Violeta claro — stop intermedio del gradient-highlight de marca */
  --color-violet-500: #8023ff; /** Violeta de marca (brandbook). Reinstalado 2026-08-05: la migracion ATOM lo habia retirado, pero el highlight tipografico violeta->naranja es de marca y se usa en las homes */
  --dimension-scale: 2rem; /** Base multiplier */
  --dimension-xs: 4px; /** Micro elements */
  --dimension-sm: 8px; /** Small elements */
  --dimension-md: 16px; /** Default elements */
  --dimension-lg: 32px; /** Large elements */
  --dimension-xl: 64px; /** Extra large elements */
  --border-radius-sm: 4px; /** Subtle rounding */
  --border-radius-lg: 8px; /** Default rounding */
  --border-radius-xl: 16px; /** Large rounding */
  --duration-0: 0ms; /** Instant, no transition */
  --duration-75: 75ms; /** Micro-interactions: checkbox, toggle */
  --duration-100: 100ms; /** Fast feedback: button press, focus ring */
  --duration-150: 150ms; /** Quick transitions: hover states, tooltips */
  --duration-200: 200ms; /** Default transition: most UI interactions */
  --duration-300: 300ms; /** Medium transitions: dropdowns, panels */
  --duration-500: 500ms; /** Slow transitions: modals, page elements */
  --duration-600: 600ms; /** ATOM duration-default — el paso base de su escala de motion (0.15/0.3/0.6/0.9/1.2s); con easing-osmo es el smoothness firma */
  --duration-700: 700ms; /** Entrance animations: hero, stagger */
  --duration-900: 900ms; /** ATOM duration-onehalf — transiciones largas de layout (ej. el shrink de su navbar) */
  --duration-1000: 1000ms; /** Long animations: skeleton shimmer, loaders */
  --duration-1200: 1200ms; /** ATOM duration-l — long motion (W6) */
  --duration-1800: 1800ms; /** ATOM duration-xl — extended motion (W6) */
  --easing-linear: linear; /** Constant speed, progress bars */
  --easing-in: cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 1, 1); /** Accelerate — elements exiting view */
  --easing-out: cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); /** ATOM expo-out — elements entering view */
  --easing-in-out: cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); /** Default — most transitions */
  --easing-spring: cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1); /** Bouncy overshoot — playful interactions */
  --easing-osmo: cubic-bezier(0.625, 0.05, 0, 1); /** ATOM signature ease */
  --letter-spacing-tighter: -0.03em; /** Display grande — el tamano abre el tracking, hay que cerrarlo */
  --letter-spacing-tight: -0.02em; /** Headings, display text */
  --letter-spacing-snug: -0.01em; /** Subtitulos y texto grande */
  --letter-spacing-normal: 0em; /** Body text (default) */
  --letter-spacing-wide: 0.04em; /** Labels, uppercase text */
  --letter-spacing-wider: 0.08em; /** Eyebrow/overline en mayusculas */
  --stagger-1: 30ms; /** W6 D3 — ATOM micro stagger (cards/list items, dense sequences) */
  --stagger-2: 50ms; /** W6 D3 — ATOM default stagger (section children, words) */
  --stagger-3: 75ms; /** W6 D3 — ATOM loose stagger (lines, large reveals) */
  --opacity-5: 0.05; /** Barely visible — skeleton shimmer, ghost elements */
  --opacity-10: 0.1; /** Disabled backgrounds, faint tints */
  --opacity-20: 0.2; /** Hover overlays, subtle highlights */
  --opacity-30: 0.3; /** Backdrop light, soft overlays */
  --opacity-50: 0.5; /** Backdrop medium, placeholder text */
  --opacity-70: 0.7; /** Backdrop heavy, dimmed content */
  --opacity-80: 0.8; /** Modal overlay, focus backdrop */
  --opacity-90: 0.9; /** Near-opaque layers, frosted glass */
  --radius-none: 0; /** Sharp corners */
  --radius-sm: calc(4 * var(--u, 1px)); /** Subtle rounding, tags, badges */
  --radius-md: calc(8 * var(--u, 1px)); /** Default — buttons, inputs, chips */
  --radius-lg: calc(12 * var(--u, 1px)); /** Cards, dropdowns */
  --radius-xl: calc(16 * var(--u, 1px)); /** Modals, large cards */
  --radius-2xl: calc(24 * var(--u, 1px)); /** Hero elements, feature cards */
  --radius-full: 9999px; /** Pills, circles, avatars */
  --rhythm-xs: calc(64 * var(--u, 1px)); /** 64 — banda densa */
  --rhythm-s: calc(80 * var(--u, 1px)); /** 64·1.25 — seccion compacta */
  --rhythm-m: calc(100 * var(--u, 1px)); /** 64·1.25² — seccion media */
  --rhythm-l: calc(125 * var(--u, 1px)); /** 64·1.25³ — seccion estandar */
  --rhythm-xl: calc(156.25 * var(--u, 1px)); /** 64·1.25⁴ — hero */
  --rhythm-xxl: calc(195.31 * var(--u, 1px)); /** 64·1.25⁵ — statement */
  --shadow-none: 0 0 #0000; /** No shadow */
  --shadow-2xs: 0 1px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05); /** Barely visible, subtle depth hint */
  --shadow-xs: 0 1px 2px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05); /** Inputs, small elements */
  --shadow-sm: 0 1px 3px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1), 0 1px 2px -1px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1); /** Cards, buttons on hover */
  --shadow-md: 0 4px 6px -1px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1), 0 2px 4px -2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1); /** Dropdowns, hover cards */
  --shadow-lg: 0 10px 15px -3px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1), 0 4px 6px -4px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1); /** Popovers, floating panels */
  --shadow-xl: 0 20px 25px -5px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1), 0 8px 10px -6px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1); /** Modals, dialogs */
  --shadow-2xl: 0 25px 50px -12px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.25); /** Full-screen overlays, hero elements */
  --spacing-0: 0; /** None */
  --spacing-1: calc(4 * var(--u, 1px)); /** Hairline gaps, icon-to-text */
  --spacing-2: calc(8 * var(--u, 1px)); /** Tight spacing, inline elements */
  --spacing-3: calc(12 * var(--u, 1px)); /** Compact groups, form fields */
  --spacing-4: calc(16 * var(--u, 1px)); /** Base unit, default gap */
  --spacing-5: calc(20 * var(--u, 1px)); /** Comfortable spacing */
  --spacing-6: calc(24 * var(--u, 1px)); /** Card padding, section inner */
  --spacing-8: calc(32 * var(--u, 1px)); /** Card padding large, group gap */
  --spacing-10: calc(40 * var(--u, 1px)); /** Section gap */
  --spacing-12: calc(48 * var(--u, 1px)); /** Large section gap */
  --spacing-14: calc(56 * var(--u, 1px)); /** ATOM gap-xl (3.5rem) */
  --spacing-16: calc(64 * var(--u, 1px)); /** Section padding */
  --spacing-20: calc(80 * var(--u, 1px)); /** Hero spacing, page margin */
  --spacing-24: calc(96 * var(--u, 1px)); /** Max spacing, hero padding */
  --spacing-30: calc(120 * var(--u, 1px)); /** ATOM section m (7.5rem) */
  --spacing-32: calc(128 * var(--u, 1px)); /** Section rhythm (8rem) */
  --spacing-40: calc(160 * var(--u, 1px)); /** ATOM section l (10rem) */
  --spacing-50: calc(200 * var(--u, 1px)); /** ATOM section xl (12.5rem) */
  --stroke-none: 0px; /** No border */
  --stroke-hairline: 1px; /** Dividers, subtle borders */
  --stroke-thin: 1.5px; /** Input borders, cards */
  --stroke-medium: 2px; /** Active states, focus rings */
  --stroke-thick: 3px; /** Accent borders, emphasis */
  --stroke-heavy: 4px; /** Decorative borders, nav indicators */
  --font-family-sans: 'Inter Tight', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; /** Primary UI and body — Inter Tight (ATOM/academy) */
  --font-family-display: 'Grift', 'Inter Tight', Georgia, serif; /** Display / hero — Grift */
  --font-family-mono: 'Interval', ui-monospace, 'Cascadia Code', monospace; /** Code and technical — Interval */
  --font-family-scribble: 'Gantol', 'Brush Script MT', cursive; /** Accent scribble — Gantol */
  --font-weight-regular: 400; /** Body text, paragraphs */
  --font-weight-medium: 500; /** Labels, emphasis, nav items */
  --font-weight-semibold: 600; /** Subheadings, buttons */
  --font-weight-bold: 700; /** Headings, display text */
  --font-weight-extrabold: 800; /** Hero display emphasis */
  --font-size-xs: calc(10.24 * var(--u, 1px)); /** Major Third 16·1.25^n — 10.24px */
  --font-size-sm: calc(12.8 * var(--u, 1px)); /** Major Third 16·1.25^n — 12.8px */
  --font-size-base: calc(16 * var(--u, 1px)); /** Major Third 16·1.25^n — 16px */
  --font-size-lg: calc(20 * var(--u, 1px)); /** Major Third 16·1.25^n — 20px */
  --font-size-xl: calc(25 * var(--u, 1px)); /** Major Third 16·1.25^n — 25px */
  --font-size-2xl: calc(31.25 * var(--u, 1px)); /** Major Third 16·1.25^n — 31.25px */
  --font-size-3xl: calc(39.06 * var(--u, 1px)); /** Major Third 16·1.25^n — 39.06px */
  --font-size-4xl: calc(48.83 * var(--u, 1px)); /** Major Third 16·1.25^n — 48.83px */
  --font-size-5xl: calc(61.04 * var(--u, 1px)); /** Major Third 16·1.25^n — 61.04px */
  --font-size-6xl: calc(76.29 * var(--u, 1px)); /** Major Third 16·1.25^n — 76.29px */
  --line-height-xs: 1.4; /** Paired with font-size-xs */
  --line-height-sm: 1.45; /** Paired with font-size-sm */
  --line-height-base: 1.5; /** Paired with font-size-base */
  --line-height-lg: 1.45; /** Paired with font-size-lg */
  --line-height-xl: 1.3; /** Paired with font-size-xl */
  --line-height-2xl: 1.25; /** Paired with font-size-2xl */
  --line-height-3xl: 1.2; /** Paired with font-size-3xl */
  --line-height-4xl: 1.15; /** Paired with font-size-4xl */
  --line-height-5xl: 1.1; /** Paired with font-size-5xl */
  --line-height-6xl: 1.05; /** Paired with font-size-6xl */
  --z-index-0: 0; /** Base layer, default stacking */
  --z-index-10: 10; /** Sticky headers, raised elements */
  --z-index-20: 20; /** Dropdowns, select menus */
  --z-index-30: 30; /** Fixed navbars, sidebars */
  --z-index-40: 40; /** Modal backdrops, overlays */
  --z-index-50: 50; /** Modals, dialogs */
  --z-index-60: 60; /** Toasts, notifications */
  --z-index-70: 70; /** Tooltips, popovers (topmost) */
  --overlay: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5); /** Modal backdrop, dim layers */
  --button-bg-tertiary: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); /** Ghost — no background */
  --button-bg-destructive-tertiary: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); /** Danger ghost */
  --button-border-primary: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0);
  --button-border-tertiary: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0);
  --button-border-destructive-primary: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0);
  --button-border-destructive-tertiary: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0);
  --button-height-xs: 28px; /** Inline actions, table rows */
  --button-height-xl: 52px; /** Hero CTAs */
  --checkbox-focus-ring-default: rgba(161, 161, 161, 0.7); /** Neutral alpha ring */
  --background: var(--color-neutral-50); /** Default page background */
  --foreground: var(--color-neutral-950); /** Default text on background */
  --card: var(--color-white); /** Card surface */
  --card-foreground: var(--color-neutral-950); /** Text on card */
  --popover: var(--color-white); /** Popover, dropdown, tooltip surface */
  --popover-foreground: var(--color-neutral-950); /** Text on popover */
  --primary: var(--color-neutral-950); /** Primary actions, high emphasis */
  --primary-hover: var(--color-neutral-800); /** Primary hover — slightly lighter */
  --primary-foreground: var(--color-neutral-50); /** Text on primary */
  --secondary: var(--color-neutral-150); /** Secondary actions, lower emphasis */
  --secondary-foreground: var(--color-neutral-900); /** Text on secondary */
  --muted: var(--color-neutral-100); /** Subtle backgrounds, disabled surfaces */
  --muted-foreground: var(--color-neutral-600); /** Subdued text, placeholders */
  --accent: var(--color-neutral-100); /** Hover/focus highlight */
  --accent-foreground: var(--color-neutral-900); /** Text on accent */
  --destructive: var(--color-coral-500); /** Error, danger, destructive actions */
  --destructive-foreground: var(--color-neutral-950); /** Text on destructive — dark for WCAG AA (white on coral.500 is 3.63:1) */
  --brand: var(--color-brand); /** Brand accent (#ff6600) */
  --brand-foreground: var(--color-neutral-950); /** Text on brand — dark for WCAG AA (white on #ff6600 is 2.94:1) */
  --success: var(--color-green-electric); /** Success state background */
  --success-foreground: var(--color-neutral-950); /** Text on success */
  --warning: var(--color-amber-500); /** Warning state background */
  --warning-foreground: var(--color-amber-950); /** Text on warning */
  --info: var(--color-sky-500); /** Informational state background */
  --info-foreground: var(--color-neutral-950); /** Text on info */
  --link: var(--color-sky-700); /** Link text on default background — dark sky, AA on neutral-50 */
  --success-text: var(--color-forest); /** Success text on default background — 15.1:1. NO es success (ese es superficie): el acento puro no se lee sobre claro */
  --warning-text: var(--color-amber-800); /** Warning text on default background — 6.8:1. amber.700 da 4.8:1 sobre el fondo pero solo 4.2:1 sobre el relleno tintado del tag: un paso mas para que sirva en los dos usos */
  --destructive-text: var(--color-coral-700); /** Destructive text on default background — 5.8:1 */
  --info-text: var(--color-sky-700); /** Info text on default background — 5.1:1. Mismo paso que link por la misma razon: sky.500 da 1.7:1 sobre claro */
  --brand-text: var(--color-orange-700); /** Brand text on default background — 6.0:1. El brand puro (#ff6600) da 2.8:1 y no es legible como texto */
  --ai: var(--color-violet-500); /** AI accent surface — el violeta de marca del gradient-highlight. Antes el intent ai no tenia color de superficie y ai-text apuntaba a forest, o sea que ai se pintaba de verde y era indistinguible de success */
  --ai-foreground: var(--color-neutral-50); /** On ai — 5.8:1 sobre violet.500 */
  --ai-text: var(--color-violet-500); /** AI accent text on default background — 5.6:1. violet.400 da 3.7:1 sobre claro, por eso el paso 500 aqui y el 400 en dark (mismo criterio que link) */
  --border: var(--color-neutral-200); /** Default borders, dividers, separators */
  --border-input: var(--color-neutral-300); /** Form input borders (slightly darker) */
  --border-focus: var(--color-neutral-900); /** Input border when focused */
  --input: var(--color-neutral-200); /** Form input borders (legacy, use border-input) */
  --ring: var(--color-neutral-950); /** Focus rings and outlines */
  --ring-width: var(--stroke-medium); /** Focus ring thickness */
  --ring-offset: var(--stroke-thin); /** Gap between element and focus ring */
  --sidebar-bg: var(--color-neutral-100); /** Sidebar background */
  --sidebar-border: var(--color-neutral-150); /** Sidebar border */
  --sidebar-active: var(--color-orange-50); /** Sidebar active item background */
  --sidebar-active-foreground: var(--color-orange-700); /** Sidebar active item text */
  --placeholder: var(--color-neutral-600); /** Input placeholder text */
  --whatsapp: var(--color-green-electric); /** Verde de marca de WhatsApp. NO es success: coincide hoy en valor pero responde a la marca del canal, no al estado semantico — si success cambia, este no */
  --whatsapp-foreground: var(--color-neutral-50); /** Texto sobre el verde de WhatsApp. Blanco por marca del canal (la guia de WhatsApp lo fija), no por calculo de contraste */
  --section-padding-xxl: var(--rhythm-xxl); /** Tercera mayor exacta via rhythm — calc(195.31 * var(--u, 1px)) */
  --section-padding-xl: var(--rhythm-xl); /** Tercera mayor exacta via rhythm — calc(156.25 * var(--u, 1px)) */
  --section-padding-l: var(--rhythm-l); /** Tercera mayor exacta via rhythm — calc(125 * var(--u, 1px)) */
  --section-padding-m: var(--rhythm-m); /** Tercera mayor exacta via rhythm — calc(100 * var(--u, 1px)) */
  --section-padding-s: var(--rhythm-s); /** Tercera mayor exacta via rhythm — calc(80 * var(--u, 1px)) */
  --section-padding-xs: var(--rhythm-xs); /** Tercera mayor exacta via rhythm — calc(64 * var(--u, 1px)) */
  --gap-xl: var(--spacing-14); /** ATOM component gap XL — 56px */
  --gap-l: var(--spacing-10); /** ATOM component gap L — 40px */
  --gap-m: var(--spacing-6); /** ATOM component gap M — 24px */
  --gap-s: var(--spacing-4); /** ATOM component gap S — 16px */
  --gap-xs: var(--spacing-3); /** ATOM component gap XS — 12px */
  --button-hover-bg-destructive-primary: var(--color-coral-700); /** Darker coral on hover */
  --button-pressed-bg-destructive-primary: var(--color-coral-700); /** Dark coral on press */
  --button-height-s: var(--spacing-8); /** 32px — compact, toolbars */
  --button-height-m: var(--spacing-10); /** 40px — standard */
  --button-height-l: var(--spacing-12); /** 48px — prominent actions */
  --button-padding-x-xs: var(--spacing-2); /** 8px */
  --button-padding-x-s: var(--spacing-3); /** 12px */
  --button-padding-x-m: var(--spacing-4); /** 16px */
  --button-padding-x-l: var(--spacing-6); /** 24px */
  --button-padding-x-xl: var(--spacing-8); /** 32px — wider for prominence */
  --button-font-size-all: var(--font-size-sm); /** 13px — same across all sizes */
  --button-bg-primary: var(--primary); /** Solid dark background */
  --button-bg-secondary: var(--background); /** White/transparent with border */
  --button-bg-destructive-primary: var(--destructive); /** Danger solid */
  --button-bg-destructive-secondary: var(--background); /** Danger outlined */
  --button-fg-primary: var(--primary-foreground); /** Light text on dark bg */
  --button-fg-secondary: var(--foreground); /** Dark text on light bg */
  --button-fg-tertiary: var(--foreground); /** Dark text, no bg */
  --button-fg-destructive-primary: var(--destructive-foreground); /** Light text on danger */
  --button-fg-destructive-secondary: var(--destructive); /** Red text on light bg */
  --button-fg-destructive-tertiary: var(--destructive); /** Red text, no bg */
  --button-border-secondary: var(--border);
  --button-border-destructive-secondary: var(--destructive);
  --button-hover-bg-primary: var(--primary-hover); /** Theme-aware primary hover */
  --button-hover-bg-secondary: var(--accent); /** Subtle highlight */
  --button-hover-bg-tertiary: var(--accent); /** Subtle highlight */
  --button-hover-bg-destructive-secondary: var(--accent); /** Subtle highlight */
  --button-hover-bg-destructive-tertiary: var(--accent); /** Subtle highlight */
  --button-pressed-bg-primary: var(--muted); /** Pressed feedback */
  --button-pressed-bg-secondary: var(--muted); /** Pressed feedback */
  --button-pressed-bg-tertiary: var(--muted); /** Pressed feedback */
  --button-pressed-bg-destructive-secondary: var(--muted); /** Pressed feedback */
  --button-pressed-bg-destructive-tertiary: var(--muted); /** Pressed feedback */
  --button-disabled-fg-all: var(--muted-foreground); /** Same for all disabled variants */
  --checkbox-bg-unchecked: var(--background); /** Surface */
  --checkbox-bg-unchecked-hover: var(--accent); /** Subtle highlight */
  --checkbox-bg-checked: var(--primary); /** Dark fill */
  --checkbox-bg-checked-hover: var(--primary-hover); /** Lighter on hover */
  --checkbox-bg-disabled: var(--muted); /** Muted for all disabled */
  --checkbox-fg-checked: var(--primary-foreground); /** Check/minus icon on primary */
  --checkbox-fg-disabled: var(--muted-foreground); /** Faded icon when disabled */
  --checkbox-border-default: var(--muted-foreground); /** Unchecked border */
  --checkbox-border-hover: var(--muted-foreground); /** Same on hover */
  --checkbox-border-disabled: var(--muted); /** Faded border */
  --checkbox-border-error: var(--destructive); /** Coral border on error */
  --link-button-fg-enabled: var(--link); /** Link text — AA-safe sky per theme */
  --link-button-fg-hover: var(--foreground); /** Full contrast on hover */
  --link-button-fg-pressed: var(--primary); /** Stronger on press */
  --link-button-fg-disabled: var(--muted-foreground); /** Muted when disabled */
  --nav-link-fg-default: var(--muted-foreground); /** Inactive nav item */
  --nav-link-fg-hover: var(--foreground); /** Full contrast on hover */
  --nav-link-fg-active: var(--foreground); /** Current page */
  --nav-link-fg-disabled: var(--muted-foreground); /** Unavailable */
